title: wildmat: full (m+1)*(n+1) bool matrix allocated per pattern-string match call
description:
## What / Why
In crates/core/src/wildmat.rs, matches_wildmat_prefolded() allocates a Vec<bool> of size (m+1)*(n+1) on every call. For LIST ACTIVE responses with thousands of groups and dozens of wildmat patterns, this produces many allocations per request.

## Fix
For patterns without wildcards, use a simple case-insensitive string comparison. For short patterns or groups, consider a two-row rolling DP (only the current and previous rows are needed), reducing allocation to O(min(m,n)) instead of O(m*n). Profile first to confirm this is a real hot path.
